children: RNS Number : 1715T  B90 Holdings PLC  03 September 2026
B90 Holdings plc, a performance marketing and MarTech business, will announce its Interim Results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on Monday 21 September 2026.
A live online presentation open to all interested parties will be held at 14:00 BST on 21 September 2026, on the Engage Investor platform.
